mapper.select: SELECT weather_date AS weatherDate, weather_type AS weatherType, weather_coef AS weatherCoef, weather_source AS weatherSource FROM TR_FC_WEATHER WHERE weather_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY weather_date DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TR_FC_WEATHER w USING (SELECT #{weatherDate} AS weather_date FROM DUAL) s ON (w.weather_date = s.weather_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET weather_type = #{weatherType}, weather_coef = #{weatherCoef}, weather_source = #{weatherSource}, update_time = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (weather_date, weather_type, weather_coef, weather_source, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{weatherDate}, #{weatherType}, #{weatherCoef}, #{weatherSource}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
